correctness.rationale: The relation is exactly rank at most two. For dimension <=2 it is total and three-variable equality games give the two classes. For dimension >=3 the exhaustive algebraic list of third-vector extensions relative to at most two stationary anchors has counts 1, q-2, q-3, (q-1)^2, q^d-q, or q^d-q^2 as applicable. Their positivity depends exactly on whether q=2, q=3, or q>=4, furnishing a three-pebble strategy at unrestricted depth. Direct noncounting three-variable formulas define zero and parallelism in dimension >=3 and separate the three field-size bins; an independent triple separates dimensions <=2. The sharp 64-vector bound follows from the minimal field order four and dimension three. Both delivered programs were executed on the package sources and matched their recorded output; finite checks corroborate but are not the infinite proof.
